info.text:
Netflix made $45B in 2025. Ads? Just 3%.
Nearly all of its $45.2B in 2025 revenue came from monthly fees; 325M+ paid memberships.
After losing 200,000 subscribers in Q1 2022, Netflix added a cheaper ad plan: $8.99 vs $19.99 for Standard in the US (prices since March 2026).
Ad revenue topped $1.5B in 2025; Netflix expects roughly $3B in 2026, and in ad-plan countries over 60% of new sign-ups pick the ads plan.
Sources: Netflix FY2025 Form 10-K, Q4 2025, Q1 2026 and Q2 2026 shareholder letters, CNBC, Variety.
News and education, not financial advice.
